top_signals.title: US Stocks Rise on AI Trade as Market Awaits More Inflation Data
top_signals.summary: US stocks closed near all-time highs, led by the technology sector, after a subdued inflation reading helped ease interest-rate hike concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: EIA Sees Massive Uptick in US Crude Oil Inventories
top_signals.summary: Crude oil inventories in the United States saw a massive increase of 17.4 million barrels during the week ending August 7, according to new data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) released on Wednesday. The increase brings commercial stockpiles to 424.4 million barrels, according to government data, which are now just 2% below the five-year average for this time of year. The EIA’s data release follows API’s figures that were released a day earlier, which reported that crude oil inventories had risen by a hefty 9.072…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
